response.summary: Jamie's profile reads as a credible, senior backend engineer with a clear specialty in distributed systems, but the About section and skills list could work harder to reinforce that positioning.

findings.title: Headline is strong and specific
findings.description: The headline names both seniority and specialty (distributed systems at scale), which reads well to both recruiters and technical peers.
findings.recommendation: Keep this framing consistent across the About section and experience bullets.

findings.title: About section doesn't mention Acme Corp by name
findings.description: The About section talks about building backend systems generally but never references the current role at Acme Corp described in the experience section.
findings.recommendation: Add one sentence naming Acme Corp and the specific systems work described in the experience bullets.

findings.title: Only one role listed
findings.description: The experience section lists a single role (Senior Backend Engineer at Acme Corp) with no earlier history.
findings.recommendation: Add prior roles if any exist, even briefly, to show career progression.

findings.title: Skills list is well-supported by experience
findings.description: Python, Distributed Systems, API Design, Kubernetes, and SQL are all backed up by the Acme Corp bullets about caching, migrations, and mentoring.
findings.recommendation: No change needed here -- this is a strength to preserve.
